title: Home Assistant Connect Aux-2 Hands-On
excerpt: Nabu Casa has released the Home Assistant Connect Aux-2, a multi-function device designed to connect non-smart appliances to smart home networks.
body_html:
Nabu Casa, the commercial entity behind the Open Home Foundation and Home Assistant, has introduced a new device called the Home Assistant Connect Aux-2.

Described as a smart home multi-tool, the hardware device is built to help users integrate traditional, non-smart devices into an automated home ecosystem. The release forms part of broader initiatives by the platform to improve overall user accessibility and ease of use.
